camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi OperateBlackNo --region cn-hangzhou --PoolKey 'FC123456****' --BlackNo '150****0000' --OperateType AddBlack --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Adds or deletes a number in a number pool blacklist. Only number pools of the AXN privacy number, AXN extension number, and 95AXN privacy number types support blacklists
description_zh: 新增或删除号池黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单
name: OperateBlackNo

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The blacklist number to manage.
Only numbers of the number pool blacklist type are supported
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的黑名单号码。
仅支持操作号池黑名单类型的号码
parameters.name: black_no

parameters.help_en:
The type of operation to perform on the blacklist. Valid values:

AddBlack: adds a number to the blacklist.
DeleteBlack: deletes a number from the blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单操作类型。取值：

AddBlack：新增黑名单。
DeleteBlack：删除黑名单
parameters.name: operate_type

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.

A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
